prompt_en: A photographic scene of palace-court life, centered on a woman with the supplied reference appearance, during a palace-court moment. The supplied image guides her facial appearance and short dark bob with wispy bangs. Preserve the reference face's soft oval proportions, dark brown eyes, straight small nose, and natural lips, with her distinctive face still legible in a three-quarter view. In an Ottoman-inspired fictional palace, she sits upright on a low divan beside an inlaid walnut writing table. A magenta silk kaftan falls in long relaxed folds over a pale inner dress. Across the magenta robe body, repeated triangular clusters each consist of exactly three yellow circular discs, visibly woven into the fabric surface. Two complete clusters on the upper front panel and two complete clusters below the waist are clearly separated from one another; the discs follow the same folded cloth plane and read as flat fabric motifs. The collar and sleeves frame her presence. Her left forearm rests on the table and her left fingertips hold down the near corner of a folded petition. Her right hand rests palm-down beside it. The petition lies halfway across the table, its unfastened cord trailing toward an empty shallow brass tray held at waist height by a waiting court messenger at the open doorway. The messenger is farther away and partly framed by the door, looking toward the petition. The woman has just turned her eyes toward the messenger while keeping her fingertips on the paper; her lips are gently parted, and the pause in the handover is readable through the space between paper and tray. Glazed blue-and-white tile panels, carved timber shutters and a worn woven runner establish the interior. Morning window light crosses the woman's cheek and catches the silk folds; the doorway remains quieter and darker. Eye-level medium-wide portrait orientation, natural 50 mm photographic perspective, face, both hands, the whole folded petition, the waiting tray and its carrier visible together. Restrained cinematic color, real skin texture and tangible fabric weight; the woman's thoughtful presence leads, with the messenger and interrupted handover forming the second visual beat.
